item.title: Leader: Signs of police force’s significant impact in recent conflicts have become more evident
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Ayatollah Sayyid Mojtaba Khamenei, the Leader of the Islamic Revolution, said, “In recent years, the significant role played by police force—spanning levels from command and staff echelons to local police stations and outposts—in ensuring security has become increasingly prominent; the impact of this role became even more evident during the second and third imposed wars.”

item.title: IRGC chief calls Hormuz security ‘a red line,’ warns enemies against interference
item.description: Tehran, IRNA - The commander-in-chief of the Islamic Revolution Guards Corps (IRGC) warns that the security of the Persian Gulf and the Strait of Hormuz is “a red line” for the Islamic Republic, and that no extra-regional power can threaten, dominate, or interfere in the strategic waterway.

item.title: Iran eyes up to $20 billion in exports to Russia: Official
item.description: Bandar Anzali, IRNA – The Head of Iran’s Trade Promotion Organization (TPO), Mohammad-Ali Dehghan Dehnavi, has called for increasing Iran’s share of the Russian market, saying the country could boost exports to Russia from the current $1–2 billion to as much as $20 billion by tapping into over $50 billion in import opportunities.
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://en.irna.ir/news/86287058/Iran-eyes-up-to-20-billion-in-exports-to-Russia-Official

Bandar Anzali, IRNA – The Head of Iran’s Trade Promotion Organization (TPO), Mohammad-Ali Dehghan Dehnavi, has called for increasing Iran’s share of the Russian market, saying the country could boost exports to Russia from the current $1–2 billion to as much as $20 billion by tapping into over $50 billion in import opportunities.

item.title: Foreign flights resume at Imam Khomeini Airport
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Foreign flights have resumed at Imam Khomeini International Airport after a 40-day interruption, with Iraqi Airways operating its first direct Najaf-Tehran service on Thursday, marking a step toward the gradual restoration of international air traffic.
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://en.irna.ir/news/86286907/Foreign-flights-resume-at-Imam-Khomeini-Airport

Tehran, IRNA – Foreign flights have resumed at Imam Khomeini International Airport after a 40-day interruption, with Iraqi Airways operating its first direct Najaf-Tehran service on Thursday, marking a step toward the gradual restoration of international air traffic.
